topic: Confirmation stalls require honest recovery evidence
problem: CUA release click timed out and confirmation was inaccessible; a helper import error then briefly produced a false success log
solution: Kept blocked click, appended explicit correction, renamed helper and released through public HTTP; standalone browser verified short/restored states
lesson: Never classify a stalled confirmation as HTTP rejection; a failed helper cannot prove a mutation; preserve correction history
